title: There's a simple way to see what your customers' skin really needs. Most brands aren't using it
summary: Many beauty brands already offer AI skin analysis on their website or in store – but only to recommend products. Added together, the same analyses show what an entire audience's skin needs. Here is how marketing teams turn them into campaign, range and assortment decisions

extraction.key_fact: 여러 뷰티 브랜드가 AI 피부 분석을 제품 추천에만 쓰고 고객 전체 수요 파악에는 쓰지 않는다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Many beauty brands already offer AI skin analysis on their website or in store – but only to recommend products.
